channel.title: Shalom Hunukumbura, blog
channel.description: One post for every project I ship.

item.title: The one-line bug that takes your whole site down
item.description: A call with no timeout passes review and every test, then holds a worker forever the day a dependency stalls. no-hang finds them in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript and Go.

item.title: The warnings you scroll past are your next upgrade outage
item.description: pytest already tells you what will break when Pydantic 3 or the next Python lands. It just says it in a way nobody reads.

item.title: 6 ways personal data gets into your Python logs (and how your tests can catch it)
item.description: Nobody writes log.info(password) on purpose. It gets in through f-strings, exceptions, dicts and connection strings.

item.title: A PayHere handler can check the signature and still give away 500 credits
item.description: PayHere tells your server about payments by POSTing to a URL you can't test on localhost. The bugs that cost money are on the paths you never click through. payhere-sim sends them all, signed, to your machine.

item.title: I checked my tax library against all 75,590 rows of the official tables
item.description: Sri Lanka's tax rules change mid-year, so lk-tax stores every rule as dated data with its source. Then I tested it against every row of the Inland Revenue's own tables, and found two rows that break the table's own rule.

item.title: 5 Alembic migrations that will take down your prod DB
item.description: They pass code review and they pass tests. Then they meet a table with real data.
